neighbours.label: the name of a cyber-attack technique at the point where 'attack' comes next (man-in-the-middle, MITM, side-channel, brute-force, replay)
fire: On public Wi-Fi, an eavesdropper can mount a man-in-the-middle attack against your browser.
The paper describes a timing side-channel attack that recovers the secret key.
Weak passwords fall quickly to a brute-force attack on the admin panel.
Without certificate pinning the app is exposed to MITM attacks on the network.
Adding a nonce to each message prevents a replay attack on the protocol.
The forum was defaced through a cross-site scripting attack last month.
Rogue access points make a man-in-the-middle attack easy to stage in an airport.
The smart card leaked its key through a power side-channel attack in the lab.
quiet: At first light, the cavalry mounted a surprise attack against the camp.
The paper describes a shark attack that injured two surfers.
Her grandfather died quickly of a heart attack on the farm.
Without warning the wolves began to attack the sheep on the hill.
Adding a striker to the squad improved the team's attack this season.
The forum was redesigned with a new colour scheme last month.
Rogue waves make a crossing hard to plan in winter.
The smart card stores its key in a sealed chip made in the lab.
